limitations: No exact timestamp for the grab force call or nonzero applied force exists in this immutable worker payload. The event→completed tick value bounds completion of the first integration opportunity with that accepted target active. Superseded targets are counted and excluded from this bound distribution.

The built-in visibleAtMs predicate observes any selected-segment movement>1e−7 plus cumulative accepted sequence and advancing tick after draw submission. It does not prove that this command caused the movement, nor GPU/compositor/display completion. Ambient warmup hand movement is separately recorded and exceeds the predicate scale.

rendererFreshnessReview.definition: snapshotAgeMs subtracts a worker-publication timestamp interpolated at the submitted presentation_time_s from main performance.now. It is a source-freshness proxy; backlog is not added, and computation before publication or physical delay against wall schedule are not directly measured.
rendererFreshnessReview.rendererBehavior: Current renderer blends from its last displayed pose/time and restarts arrival on each accepted snapshot; multiple replies before the next drawn frame can preserve stale displayed state. No renderer fix is claimed in this evidence.
rendererFreshnessReview.coldInitialization: The manual tick0 readiness/screenshot setup retains the old initial source timestamp. It affects full-window maxima, but removing only displayed times<.025s still leaves p95 ages113.36/114.35/102.18ms. The separately labeled warm tick≥120 p95~96–100ms remains unexplained by that cold source.
